leaves.name: mainTheoremCM
leaves.doc: qmrec-printed: the main theorem of complex multiplication, adelic form with torsion (printed form): for a CM field E with CM type Phi, its reflex field E* (generated by the type traces) and reflex norm N (det_E on a model of C^Phi over E*), sigma in Aut(C) and an idele s of E* with sigma = [s, E*] on E*^ab (Tau Ceti's Artin map), an abelian variety A/C uniformized by C^g/Phi(a) of type (E, Phi): A^sigma is uniformized by C^g/Phi(t^-1 a), t = N(s)^eps, with theta(Phi(x))^sigma = theta'(Phi(y)) whenever t y - x lies in a-hat. Sign eps existential (Shimura's normalization: eps = 1). Proves QMReciprocityL3 (qmReciprocityL3_of_textbook).
leaves.source: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971) section 5.5; Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 18, Thm 18.6; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) sections 13-14; Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) Thm 11.2; Milne, Complex multiplication (notes) section 9 (locators UNVERIFIED)
